name: Spicy African Peanut Curry with Sweet Potato, Kale, Cilantro & Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 3 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup basmati rice
chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
1 jalapeño pepper
¾ lb sweet potato
1 bunch kale
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, jalapeño, onion, curry powder, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tbsp curry powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and medium dice sweet potato.

When the onion is soft, add sweet potato, tomatoes, broth, and peanut butter to the pot. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until sweet potato is fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes
chicken or vegetable broth
¼ cup natural peanut butter

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the kale.
When the sweet potato is tender, add kale and cilantro to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine the curry and remove from heat.

Divide rice and curry between storage containers, then set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat soup in a saucepan or microwave and enjoy!
